name: Geestland (Germany)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist by a white bend sinister, blue above and red below, charged at the centre with the city arms of Geestland (a wavy bend, a key and a wheel on red and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Geestland; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Geestland arms — wavy bend, key and wheel
